segments.oily: One reviewer with oily to combination skin reports the toner absorbs without leaving an oily film, leaving her skin plump, smooth, and hydrated with no irritation or breakouts, unlike other, more expensive serums she has tried.
segments.combination: The same reviewer with oily to combination skin says the toner never feels heavy or greasy despite her skin type, and another reviewer recommends the product specifically for dry or combination skin.
segments.dry: A reviewer who describes her skin as chronically dry says the toner is very moisturizing and hydrating and has helped soften the look of fine lines, leaving her skin more supple; another reviewer recommends the product specifically for dry or combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one whose skin became more sensitive with age and another who simply calls her skin sensitive, report the toner is gentle, tolerable, and does not feel harsh.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin says she appreciates the toner's gentle acids for sloughing off dead skin cells as part of her routine.

concerns.aging: One reviewer with chronically dry skin reports the toner helped soften the look of fine lines, alongside increased moisture and glow.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report their skin feels noticeably more hydrated, soft, and plump after use, including one who says she used to wake up with dry, tight skin and now wakes up hydrated; no reviewer reports the toner leaving skin dry.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports noticing less redness on her face over time with continued use; no other reviewer discusses redness.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in dark spots, post-acne marks, or hyperpigmentation with continued use over several weeks, along with a more even skin tone, though one review notes that deeper pigmentation may take longer to fade.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including one with oily to combination skin who specifically notes no irritation or breakouts and another who saw fewer comedones after several weeks of use; one reviewer, however, says the toner consistently breaks her out.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily to combination skin reports the toner hydrates without leaving an oily film on the skin, unlike other products that felt heavy or greasy on her.

extraits.texte: I felt more like a heavy runny lotion rather than a lightweight clarifying toner. I guess I was just expecting a different consistency rather than a pink lotion so this had nothing to do with the product. It’s not just my speed of what I was looking for.
Its good for a 99% txa but everytime i use it breaks me out..

I absolutely love this stuff. This is legit a non-negotiable when it comes to my skin care routine (if you could even call it that, a skin care routine because im a bare minimum girly most the time) I do have chronically dry skin though and this is so moisturizing and hydrating, which in turn has helped tremendously with my fine lines and makes my skin look more glowy and supple. Seriously dont take my word for it, try it for yourself.

This is second time purchasing this toner, and I do t have enough good things to say about it. If you like your toner to have a milky consistency, you’ll enjoy this. Beyond the consistency, it makes my skin have a beautiful glow and super soft. Over time, I have also noticed less redness on my face. When this bottle runs out, I’ll be buying another one.

This is a very nice toner! It's different from any other toner I've tried, but I really like it. Instead of being clear and watery, it is milky and pink. It looks a lot like Pepto Bismol, but it is thinner, more like a milky consistency. It goes on so smoothly and feels moisturizing and refreshing rather than astringent. I am a big fan of niacinamide, but this is my first experience with tranexamic acid (TXA). This toner also has seven (7!) types of hyaluronic acid, which is my favorite moisturizing ingredient. Plus, there's panthenol, ceramides and vitamin C-- so many beauty benefit ingredients! I like the opening in the bottle, it's not exactly a dropper, but it is a small opening that lets you pour out just a little at a time, and a little is all you need. It doesn't take much of this toner to cover my face and neck, and if there is any left over in the palms of my hands, I spread it on my elbows and forearms. It feels so smooth and moisturizing. This toner reminds me of a toner and serum combined. It's thinner than a serum, but more moisturizing than a toner. I use it on just-washed skin and follow with my favorite moisturizer. Overall, this stuff is different, but I love it. It's also a fun pink color. It leaves my skin feeling so smooth and moisturized, and as someone with mature skin, I love the gentle acids for sloughing off dead skin cells to keep my skin as fresh as possible. Followed by my favorite face cream, it's a big win.

Este producto me encantó, llevo usándolo alrededor de un cuatro semanas tanto el tóner el cual utilizo después de cada lavado de cara por lo general dos a tres veces al día y el serum, el cual utilizo sólo en las noches. En el transcurso de estas semanas he podido notar la disminución de las manchas. Además, también he notado disminución en las lesiones de comedones. Mi piel está menos brotada y más despigmentada. Aunque también es cierto que me ayudó de otros productos Sé que estos han sido pieza clave en mi proceso de Reparacion de mi piel. Algo que cabe rescatar es que además tengo una disminución en el tamaño de mis poros y mi piel tiene más Glow. Cuando los compré, me fijé en dos cosas: los componentes y sus porcentajes y el precio. Porque definitivamente tienen un precio muy accesible y con el uso he podido identificar que también son muy buenos. Mi piel con los años ha vuelto sensible y puedo asegurar que estos dos productos son gentiles con la piel. El serum tiene un sistema de micro agujas pero a mi parecer es muy tolerable. Me imagino que ese sistema de micro agujas está diseñado para simular el nanopore. En conclusión recomiendo mucho los productos de Aprilskin. No tengo fotos del proceso antes y después pero les puedo asegurar que si he visto mucha mejoría. Los volveré a comprar y completaré la rutina porque estos son sólo dos de cuatro pasos.

extraits.titre: Oily to combo skin- Linda listen
extraits.texte: I don’t say this lightly—the April Skin Is completely changing my face in just the short time that I've had it. my mind about what hydration is supposed to feel like, is not what it actually is. I have oily to combination skin, so I’m always careful with serums because a lot of them end up feeling heavy or greasy on me. This brand.... Not even close. It soaks in beautifully and leaves my skin feeling plump, smooth, and actually hydrated without that oily film sitting on top. And I look awake For the first time in 40 years I look awake. I used to avoid products that promised that “glowy” look because I thought it would just make me look shiny… but this is a healthy, lit-from-within glow—not grease. I’ve spent serious money on skincare over the years (I’m talking $40+ for a tiny bottle), and honestly, this serum holds its own against all of them. The price point for what you’re getting is kind of crazy. Since adding this into my routine, my skin looks more even, more awake, and just overall healthier. No irritation, no breakouts—just consistent, noticeable results. If you have oily or combo skin and you’re hesitant like I was, just try it. This serum might surprise you the way it did me.
